scope: Small curated guide examples, separate from the full bibliography. No ranking or measured results.
unknown_policy: Missing or null values mean unknown, never zero, free, permitted, or unavailable.

items.name: AppWorld
items.summary: Stateful application task environments with state-based evaluation.
items.summary_zh: 带状态评测的有状态应用任务环境。
limitations: Application tasks and verification do not establish fidelity to arbitrary real services.

items.name: ToolSandbox
items.summary: Stateful tool scenarios evaluated using ordered milestones.
items.summary_zh: 使用有序里程碑评测的有状态工具场景。
limitations: Scenario and milestone coverage bound the conclusions.

items.name: EnvScaler
items.summary: Generation of executable stateful agent environments.
items.summary_zh: 生成可执行的有状态 Agent 环境。
limitations: Generation requires separate behavioral and verifier validation.

items.name: StableToolBench-MirrorAPI
items.summary: A published approach to modeling real API environments.
items.summary_zh: 对真实 API 环境建模的已发表方案。
limitations: Reported API coverage is not evidence of complete real-service state fidelity.
